title: WHO AWaRe antibiotic classification (2023) — draft baseline
summary: WHO/global baseline AWaRe (Access / Watch / Reserve) categorisation of commonly-used antibiotics. The categorisation is factual classification data (not reproduced WHO prose) and is the global fallback layer every country inherits until a national antimicrobial-stewardship overlay is authored. DRAFT — a clinician must verify every entry against the current WHO AWaRe list before this is promoted to approved and signed into a bundle release.

stewardshipTargets.accessProportionTarget: >=60% of total antibiotic use should be Access-tier (WHO/NFR-AMR).

references.label: WHO AWaRe (Access, Watch, Reserve) classification of antibiotics for evaluation and monitoring of use, 2023
